أتذبذب (form IIq)
# أَتَذَبْذَبُ (ʔataḏabḏabu) /ʔa.ta.ðab.ða.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَذَبْذَبَ (taḏabḏaba)
# أَتَذَبْذَبَ (ʔataḏabḏaba) /ʔa.ta.ðab.ða.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَذَبْذَبَ (taḏabḏaba)
# أَتَذَبْذَبْ (ʔataḏabḏab) /ʔa.ta.ðab.ðab/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَذَبْذَبَ (taḏabḏaba)
